{
  "what": "An agent skill that turns code into a README with tested commands and a checked first screen.",
  "forWhom": "Developers using coding agents who want clearer, more convincing project READMEs.",
  "firstCommand": "gh repo clone bmdy6/skill-readme-from-code .agents/skills/readme-from-code -- --branch feat/v0.1",
  "wouldTry": "yes",
  "why": "The before-and-after example makes the improvement tangible, and testing the commands would help make the README trustworthy.",
  "whatOutput": "An improved README with a clearer description and a terminal capture showing actual example output. The example turns JSON notes into a daily Markdown digest.",
  "mostAppealing": "Showing real command output so readers can see what the project actually does.",
  "confusing": [
    "Which coding agents support this skill and what prerequisites are needed?",
    "The instruction after “Then tell your agent:” is below the visible screen.",
    "The 100/100 audit score does not show which checks passed.",
    "It is unclear whether the skill automatically creates the terminal capture and verifies the rendered README."
  ]
}
